pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: drm/edid: Fix up DMT modes Liu Lei noticed that our 1856x1392@75Hz DMT mode doesn't match the spec. Fix that up, and also fix up a few other inconsistencies I discovered by parsing the spec (DMT version 1.0, revision 13) and comparing the results to our current DMT mode table. Also clean up the indentation mess for the 1024x768i mode. BUG=b:74047338 TEST=connect external monitor via DELL DA200, check all resolutions can be displayed. Cc: "liu,lei" <lei.a.liu@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjl <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com> Reviewed-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com> Signed-off-by: Daniel Vetter <daniel.vetter@ffwll.ch> (cherry picked from commit fcf22d0567ad6cea6d2e84f28bbfa8c73642e899) Signed-off-by: Vincente Tsou <vincente.tsou@intel.com> Change-Id: I1c508442c9261dc874211ac562703c2ac05a439f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/948004 Commit-Ready: Vincente Tsou <vincente.tsou@intel.com> Tested-by: Vincente Tsou <vincente.tsou@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: drm/edid: Add DMT modes with ID > 0x50 DMT Version 1.0, Rev. 13 lists a bunch of new modes we don't currently have in our dmt mode table. So add them. The order may look a bit weird since it's not sorted based on the DMT ID, but this is the order they appear in the standard. I suppose they are ordered by the resolution, pixel clock, or some such factor. I decided that it's perhaps best to keep the same order as the spec. BUG=b:74047338 TEST=connect external monitor via DELL DA200, check all resolutions can be displayed. Cc: "liu,lei" <lei.a.liu@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjl <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com> Reviewed-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com> Signed-off-by: Daniel Vetter <daniel.vetter@ffwll.ch> (cherry picked from commit bfcd74d2aeda25a78f7cc92f80650218b1bce0ca) Signed-off-by: Vincente Tsou <vincente.tsou@intel.com> Change-Id: If63be308672f185cf49ee674d1f498eb21caa760 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/948342 Commit-Ready: Vincente Tsou <vincente.tsou@intel.com> Tested-by: Vincente Tsou <vincente.tsou@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>
